market_read: Week 6 snapshot: 18 verified rows (0 new, 18 persisting), 0 indicative; one listing removed. The Santa Cruz Bubukal raw flat land (42,000 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm asking) is no longer accessible — its Dot Property URL redirects to a generic search page and it is absent from the Santa Cruz category page — marking the dataset's first probable clearing or delisting after six weeks at that asking price. Verified range PHP 269–3,000/sqm; dataset median PHP 1,200/sqm, unchanged. Pagsanjan-core median (8 rows) holds at PHP 975/sqm; ring median eases from PHP 1,500 to PHP 1,350/sqm, a compositional shift from losing one PHP 2,000/sqm comparable rather than an actual price reduction. All 18 persisting listings show no price movement; the two Cavinti lake-view farm lots (Kanluran Talaongan PHP 2,204/sqm, Sisilmin PHP 2,800/sqm) are now in their sixth consecutive week unchanged. The Bubukal delisting at PHP 2,000/sqm is the first market-action data point in this dataset and is consistent with — though does not confirm — PHP 2,000/sqm as a level where buyers engage for larger raw parcels in the ring. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, the tightest comparables remain Maulawin (4,767 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm) and Bulilan Norte/Pila (6,447 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm); recommended asking range PHP 1,600–2,000/sqm; fastest-sale price PHP 1,400/sqm, both unchanged.
